As a rental manager, I want to add a new vehicle with registration number, name, type, and daily rental rate so that it becomes available for booking.
Acceptance Criteria: Given valid vehicle data, when I submit the form, then the vehicle is saved and a success message is shown.

Description: As a rental manager, I want to view all vehicles in a table so that I can see the current fleet.
Acceptance Criteria: Given vehicles exist, when I visit the vehicles page, then all vehicles are displayed in a table with registration, name, type, rate, and status.

Description: As a rental manager, I want to edit vehicle details so that I can update information like name, type, rate, or status.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a vehicle exists, when I edit and submit, then the vehicle record is updated and a success message is shown.

Description: As a rental manager, I want to search vehicles by name or registration and filter by type and status.
Acceptance Criteria: Given vehicles exist, when I search or filter, then only matching vehicles are displayed.

Description: As a rental manager, I want to delete a vehicle only if it has no booking history so that historical records are preserved.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a vehicle with no bookings, when I delete, then it is removed. Given a vehicle with bookings, when I delete, then an error is shown.

Description: As a system, I need to validate all vehicle fields server-side to prevent invalid data entry.
Acceptance Criteria: Registration must be unique and required. Name and type are required. Rate must be positive. Clear error messages are shown for violations.

Description: As a rental manager, I want to create a booking by selecting a vehicle, entering customer name, and rental dates.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a valid vehicle and dates, when I submit, then a booking is created with server-calculated amount and unique ID.

Description: As a system, I need to calculate the rental price server-side using inclusive day counting.
Acceptance Criteria: total_days = (end_date - start_date).days + 1; total_amount = total_days × daily_rate. Browser-submitted prices are never trusted.

Description: As a system, I need to prevent double-booking a vehicle for overlapping date ranges.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an active booking for dates A-B, when a new booking for overlapping dates is attempted, then it is rejected with an error.

Description: As a rental manager, I want to cancel an active booking so that the reserved dates are released.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an active booking, when I cancel, then status changes to 'cancelled' and the dates are available for new bookings.

Description: As a rental manager, I want to view all bookings with vehicle info, customer, dates, amount, and status.
Acceptance Criteria: Given bookings exist, when I visit the bookings page, then all bookings are displayed with complete details.

Description: As a rental manager, I want to view detailed information about a specific booking.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a booking exists, when I view it, then all booking and vehicle details are shown with rental calculation breakdown.

Description: As a system, I need to validate all booking fields including date ranges and vehicle existence.
Acceptance Criteria: Required fields enforced. Past dates rejected. End >= start enforced. Nonexistent vehicle rejected. Maintenance vehicles rejected.

Description: As a system, I need to preserve all booking records including cancelled ones for historical reference.
Acceptance Criteria: Cancelled bookings remain in the database with status='cancelled'. Vehicles with booking history cannot be deleted.

Description: As a rental manager, I want a dashboard showing vehicle counts, booking counts, revenue, and recent bookings.
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard shows total/available/rented/maintenance vehicles, active/cancelled/completed bookings, total revenue, and last 5 bookings.

Description: As a developer, I want automated tests for all vehicle CRUD operations and validations.
Acceptance Criteria: At least 20 tests covering creation, validation, duplicates, search, filter, update, deletion, and page rendering. All tests pass.

Description: As a developer, I want automated tests for all booking operations and business rules.
Acceptance Criteria: At least 20 tests covering creation, validation, dates, calculation, overlap, cancellation, rebooking, and persistence. All tests pass.

Description: As a developer, I want to run all tests and fix any defects discovered.
Acceptance Criteria: All tests executed. Failures analyzed. Defects fixed. Retesting confirms fixes. Results documented.
